Meet the Team 

The Auto Tagger team is the engine behind our data flywheel, responsible for translating petabytes of raw, multi-modal vehicle data into a highly curated library of critical driving scenarios. By mining driving logs for long-tail events, we provide the foundational data required for safe autonomous trucking. Leveraging Pegasus logical layers, this team structures and catalogs findings into an observations database that directly accelerates development across autonomous perception, sensor fusion, and generative simulation testing.

• Design and implement event-detection algorithms over multi-sensor time-series data (ego kinematics, perception object tracks, lane and map geometry) using temporal logic, state machines, signal processing, and geometric reasoning in road-relative frames.

• Combine rule-based logic with learned components (classifiers, embeddings, Vision-Language Models) where heuristics hit their ceiling, and make the call on which approach fits each scenario.

• Build evaluation for the taggers you write: ground-truth sets, per-scenario precision and recall, failure analysis, and regression tests that catch quality drift
